verdict.rationale: Conductor's 'routines' feature explicitly lets agents run on a schedule or via GitHub Action, and cloud workspaces/sandboxes continue running autonomously after the user closes their laptop, with agents able to test, build, and update scripts without requiring step-by-step confirmation — core building blocks of autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that routines/scheduled automation work reliably in practice, and more detail on monitoring or failure handling of unattended runs.
